   "source": [
    "# ============================================================\n",
    "# DECISION TREE USING ID3 - ONLINE RETAIL CUSTOMER SEGMENTATION\n",
    "# ============================================================\n",
    "\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "# 1. Import Libraries\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "\n",
    "import pandas as pd\n",
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "import time\n",
    "\n",
    "from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split\n",
    "from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier, plot_tree\n",
    "from sklearn.metrics import (\n",
    "    accuracy_score,\n",
    "    classification_report,\n",
    "    confusion_matrix\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "# 2. Load Online Retail Dataset\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "\n",
    "file_path = \"Online Retail.xlsx\"\n",
    "\n",
    "df = pd.read_excel(file_path)\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"Original Dataset Shape:\", df.shape)\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"\\nFirst 5 rows:\")\n",
    "print(df.head())\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "# 3. Data Preprocessing\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "\n",
    "# Remove rows where CustomerID is missing\n",
    "df = df.dropna(subset=[\"CustomerID\"])\n",
    "\n",
    "# Remove cancelled invoices\n",
    "df = df[~df[\"InvoiceNo\"].astype(str).str.startswith(\"C\")]\n",
    "\n",
    "# Remove invalid quantities\n",
    "df = df[df[\"Quantity\"] > 0]\n",
    "\n",
    "# Remove invalid prices\n",
    "df = df[df[\"UnitPrice\"] > 0]\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"\\nDataset after cleaning:\", df.shape)\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "# 4. Create Total Amount\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "\n",
    "df[\"TotalAmount\"] = df[\"Quantity\"] * df[\"UnitPrice\"]\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "# 5. Convert InvoiceDate\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "\n",
    "df[\"InvoiceDate\"] = pd.to_datetime(df[\"InvoiceDate\"])\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "# 6. Create Customer-Level Features\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "\n",
    "# Reference date\n",
    "reference_date = df[\"InvoiceDate\"].max() + pd.Timedelta(days=1)\n",
    "\n",
    "customer_data = df.groupby(\"CustomerID\").agg({\n",
    "\n",
    "    \"InvoiceDate\": lambda x: (reference_date - x.max()).days,\n",
    "\n",
    "    \"InvoiceNo\": \"nunique\",\n",
    "\n",
    "    \"TotalAmount\": \"sum\",\n",
    "\n",
    "    \"Quantity\": \"sum\"\n",
    "\n",
    "})\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# Rename columns\n",
    "\n",
    "customer_data.columns = [\n",
    "    \"Recency\",\n",
    "    \"Frequency\",\n",
    "    \"Monetary\",\n",
    "    \"TotalQuantity\"\n",
    "]\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# Average Order Value\n",
    "\n",
    "customer_data[\"AverageOrderValue\"] = (\n",
    "    customer_data[\"Monetary\"] /\n",
    "    customer_data[\"Frequency\"]\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"\\nCustomer-level data:\")\n",
    "print(customer_data.head())\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"\\nNumber of customers:\",\n",
    "      len(customer_data))\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "# 7. Create Customer Segments\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "\n",
    "# Use Monetary spending to create 3 customer segments.\n",
    "\n",
    "customer_data[\"Segment\"] = pd.qcut(\n",
    "    customer_data[\"Monetary\"],\n",
    "    q=3,\n",
    "    labels=[\n",
    "        \"Low Value\",\n",
    "        \"Medium Value\",\n",
    "        \"High Value\"\n",
    "    ],\n",
    "    duplicates=\"drop\"\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"\\nCustomer Segment Distribution:\")\n",
    "print(customer_data[\"Segment\"].value_counts())\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "# 8. Prepare Features and Target\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "\n",
    "features = [\n",
    "    \"Recency\",\n",
    "    \"Frequency\",\n",
    "    \"TotalQuantity\",\n",
    "    \"AverageOrderValue\"\n",
    "]\n",
    "\n",
    "X = customer_data[features]\n",
    "\n",
    "y = customer_data[\"Segment\"]\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "# 9. Train-Test Split\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "\n",
    "X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(\n",
    "    X,\n",
    "    y,\n",
    "    test_size=0.20,\n",
    "    random_state=42,\n",
    "    stratify=y\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"\\nTraining samples:\", len(X_train))\n",
    "print(\"Testing samples :\", len(X_test))\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "# 10. Implement ID3 Decision Tree\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "\n",
    "# criterion=\"entropy\" implements the ID3 splitting criterion.\n",
    "\n",
    "start_time = time.time()\n",
    "\n",
    "id3_tree = DecisionTreeClassifier(\n",
    "    criterion=\"entropy\",\n",
    "    random_state=42,\n",
    "    max_depth=5\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "id3_tree.fit(X_train, y_train)\n",
    "\n",
    "training_time = time.time() - start_time\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "# 11. Make Predictions\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "\n",
    "start_time = time.time()\n",
    "\n",
    "y_pred = id3_tree.predict(X_test)\n",
    "\n",
    "prediction_time = time.time() - start_time\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "# 12. Calculate Accuracy\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "\n",
    "accuracy = accuracy_score(\n",
    "    y_test,\n",
    "    y_pred\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"\\n======================================\")\n",
    "print(\"             MODEL RESULTS\")\n",
    "print(\"======================================\")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"Accuracy       :\", round(accuracy, 4))\n",
    "print(\"Training time  :\", round(training_time, 4), \"seconds\")\n",
    "print(\"Prediction time:\", round(prediction_time, 4), \"seconds\")\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "# 13. Classification Report\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"\\n======================================\")\n",
    "print(\"        CLASSIFICATION REPORT\")\n",
    "print(\"======================================\")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\n",
    "    classification_report(\n",
    "        y_test,\n",
    "        y_pred\n",
    "    )\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "# 14. Confusion Matrix\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "\n",
    "cm = confusion_matrix(\n",
    "    y_test,\n",
    "    y_pred\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"\\nConfusion Matrix:\")\n",
    "print(cm)\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "# 15. Visualize Decision Tree\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.figure(figsize=(20, 10))\n",
    "\n",
    "plot_tree(\n",
    "    id3_tree,\n",
    "    feature_names=features,\n",
    "    class_names=[\n",
    "        \"Low Value\",\n",
    "        \"Medium Value\",\n",
    "        \"High Value\"\n",
    "    ],\n",
    "    filled=True,\n",
    "    rounded=True,\n",
    "    fontsize=9\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.title(\n",
    "    \"ID3 Decision Tree for Customer Segmentation\"\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.show()\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "# 16. Feature Importance\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "\n",
    "importance = pd.DataFrame({\n",
    "\n",
    "    \"Feature\": features,\n",
    "\n",
    "    \"Importance\": id3_tree.feature_importances_\n",
    "\n",
    "})\n",
    "\n",
    "importance = importance.sort_values(\n",
    "    by=\"Importance\",\n",
    "    ascending=False\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"\\n======================================\")\n",
    "print(\"          FEATURE IMPORTANCE\")\n",
    "print(\"======================================\")\n",
    "\n",
    "print(importance.to_string(index=False))\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "# 17. Feature Importance Graph\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.bar(\n",
    "    importance[\"Feature\"],\n",
    "    importance[\"Importance\"]\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.xlabel(\"Features\")\n",
    "plt.ylabel(\"Importance\")\n",
    "plt.title(\"Feature Importance in ID3 Decision Tree\")\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.xticks(rotation=30)\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.show()\n",
    "\n",
    "\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "# 18. Customer Segment Visualization\n",
    "# ------------------------------------------------------------\n",
    "\n",
    "segment_counts = customer_data[\"Segment\"].value_counts()\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.bar(\n",
    "    segment_counts.index.astype(str),\n",
    "    segment_counts.values\n",
    ")\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.xlabel(\"Customer Segment\")\n",
    "plt.ylabel(\"Number of Customers\")\n",
    "plt.title(\"Customer Segmentation\")\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.tight_layout()\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.show()"
   ]
  },
